author: Zhang Yaxing
implementation_note: sha256 of code/submission.py (frozen inference path, incl. feature builder)
model: linear scorer over per-candidate features, ListNet group-softmax objective, 10-seed weight average
selection: Validation used for development and selection; test references used only for the two official scores after freezing. Ten-seed weight averaging chosen over single seeds (single-seed val 89.72-92.36).
determinism: retraining reproduces model.npz bit-identically (same sha256) on the dev machine
fallback: without --checkpoint, predict() degrades to deterministic majority vote (legal training-free baseline)
